current_stage.description: D104: found the real root cause of the ENOSPC crashes -- the pmtiles library Writer buffers tile bytes in tempfile.TemporaryFile() on TMPDIR (boot disk, only ~100GB free), not on the output volume (962GB free), so 4 parallel workers exhausted the boot disk. Fixed by setting TMPDIR=/Volumes/pmtiles-store/tmp-store/writer-scratch/ (same fix D99 already used for merge_japan_bundles.py, just not previously applied to bundle.py). Restarted as bundle_rebuild4. Publish to stars remains on hold.
